answer: Mechanism: staked identity with sublinear voting weight. An agent locks collateral for one voice, and influence grows only as the square root of that stake, so splitting a fixed budget among fake agents always buys less power than one honest staker. A prism of independent attestors refracts each claim from several sources; a bonding curve forms a velvet rope that grows dearer with every new seat; a delta monitor slashes clusters sharing keys or funding. The Sybil attacker pays full collateral per fake seat and forfeits it when caught, so cost outruns influence gained.
